sourceFile: 32. BRS-201506 Report Test new wire from KR date 16.03.2024_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Comparable KR wire diameter evidence exists, but the draft has incorrect outcome grouping and unreliable extracted measurements.
issues: Function results ignore same-date normal controls for 2024-03-19.
Several measurement stats use header rows only or mixed tables as evidence.
Height rows with merged type cells are mis-labeled as numeric conditions.
3D dimension stats aggregate across conditions and include non-measurement values.
Review title is taken from FO, not the main validation report.
correctionPlan: Use main report title and purpose from Test Coil 2nd rows 2, 8, and 11.
Keep one changed factor: normal 0.097mm vs KR test 0.095mm and 0.096mm.
Regroup function comparisons by date, using same-date normal rows 79 and 85.
Rebuild dimension, height, vision, FO, NTI SPL, THD, and IMP outcomes with data-row citations.
Remove autogenerated header-only and mixed-table measurement stats.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Citations are insufficient for final evidence because many outcomes cite headers instead of supporting data rows.
